title: related lists: an action id the related object does not define draws a refusal notice above the list for whoever opens the record — an authoring fault shown to end users; scope it to authors/admins
body:
Filing gate: **② a design question with reach read.** reach: every record page whose `record:related_list` names an action id the related object does not define. That is an authoring fault, and objectstack-ai/objectstack#20936 made it reachable at runtime. Raised by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`session_01ER8ntXZhYebyQ66aXWdjfT`) during the hotcrm 17.7.0 upgrade (hotcrm PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#2008), on the maintainer's word: 「11. 无效配置以前被静默丢弃 … 以上立卡」.

**Who acts on it:** objectstack triage. The renderer is objectui's, so this is a seam card for the objectui half; the `repo:hotcrm` seat's scope does not reach objectui. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What 17.7.0 says it does

`os validate` on hotcrm refused the lead page's Tasks list (`actions: ['new_task', 'edit', 'complete']`; `crm_task` defines no action) with:

> *Related-list actions names action "new_task", which is not an action of the related object "crm_task" (no action in this stack defines it). The list resolves each id against its related object's own actions only … so it draws no button for this one, **only a refusal notice naming it above the list**.* … *Actions of "crm_task": (none).*

The author-time half is right and well worded: it names the object, the reason and the list of valid ids. hotcrm removed the three ids (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#2008).

## The question

Before objectstack-ai/objectstack#20936 / objectui#11163 the ids were dropped silently. Now the console draws a refusal notice above the list. The validator text gives it no audience qualifier, so as worded, a sales rep opening a lead sees a configuration error about action ids they cannot act on.

**Not measured:** who actually sees the notice. hotcrm removed the ids before its browser pass, and objectui's role gating was not read.

## A direction, for triage to rule on (⛔ not a ruling)

- Show the notice only to a viewer who can change the page (an admin or the metadata's author), or in dev mode. Draw nothing extra for end users; the build-time refusal already reaches the author.
- Keep `os validate`'s refusal as is. It is the primary channel and it already lists the related object's drawable actions.

## Duplicate check

Semantic issue search on objectstack, *related list action id refusal notice shown to end users action-name-undefined*: 5 hits, all closed.
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#20936 and objectstack-ai/objectstack#20665 made `record:related_list.actions` enforced and read.
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#20937 and objectstack-ai/objectstack#20105 cover neighbouring action-ref lints.
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#12716 is about approvals.

None is about who sees the runtime notice. Positive control: objectstack-ai/objectstack#20936 is the first hit.

Dedupe words: related list refusal notice end users · action-name-undefined runtime notice · authoring error visible to users · record:related_list actions notice
